Paths, Crop & Library

Version 0.6.0, November 1, 2026

Added path drawing, area selections, canvas cropping and text editing, expanded animation timing and playback, introduced SVG import and export, and rebuilt the workspace around one Library window.

Added

  • Added the Pen and Line tools and Path layers: draw straight or curved paths, lines, and arrows, edit their points, and give each a glitter or color stroke, fill, and outline. Show me
  • Added the Select Area tool: draw rectangles, ellipses, freehand or polygon lassos, pick colors with the Magic Wand, select layer pixels, preview Expand/Contract/Border/Smooth, undo and reselect areas, and turn them into Path layers. Fill, Erase, Crop, Brush and Glitter Fill all use the area. Show me
  • Added the Crop tool with canvas handles, aspect ratios, extension fill, keyboard and touch controls, and one-step undo. Fit the canvas to artwork, its motion, selected layers, a selected area, trimmed transparent edges, or hidden artwork. Show me
  • Added SVG import as editable Path layers, with supported outlines grouped by paint. Files using unsupported features open as images, with the reason shown in the status line. Show me
  • Added Animation loop controls for an automatic or custom document length, a table of animation sources, Fit animations to loop, Restore previous timing, and Set loop to include content. Saved timing can be restored after reopening a project. Show me
  • Added Scene preview with Play/Pause, a scene-time slider, frame stepping, and a return to the loop start. Pausing holds the current time, and playback controls work with the timeline closed and on phones. Show me
  • Added Appears and Disappears times to show a layer for only part of the animation, including layers without motion. Show me
  • Added GIF Cycle controls for animated stickers, frame images, and the Base Image, so their animation can play faster, slower, or fit the document loop. Show me
  • Added Start at for animated stickers, frame images, the Base Image, and glitter textures, and Randomize GIF starts for a selection, so copies of one GIF no longer blink in lockstep. Show me
  • Animated GIFs opened as the Base Image now play on the canvas and in exports, with a Play animation switch in Canvas Properties. Auto Glitter is unavailable while they play. Show me
  • Added animated Scanlines crawl and a Hue Cycle filter that rotates the colors of the artwork beneath it, with matching playback and export. Show me
  • Added the Timeline on desktop, with draggable timing bars, snapping, zoom, output-frame markers, and export-frame playback. Open it from the Timeline button in the top bar or the View menu. Select several bars to move, align, stagger, fit, reset, or paste timing together in one undo step. Show me
  • Added Stagger animations for a multi-selection: each layer's motion starts one step after the last, in reading order, so split letters wave, bounce, or pop in one by one. Show me
  • Added Custom motion with editable keys and easing, conversion from supported presets, and desktop canvas controls for posing position, rotation, and scale keys. Show me
  • Added canvas text editing and drag-to-create text boxes, with Point, Auto Height, and Fixed sizing, overflow feedback, and Fit box to text. Show me
  • Expanded text formatting with color emoji, justified alignment, underline, strikethrough, symbols, alternating caps, plain-text paste, and splitting text into characters, words, or lines. Show me
  • Added l33t, ｆｕｌｌｗｉｄｔｈ, and ᴛɪɴʏ ᴄᴀᴘꜱ text styles, a Wrap menu for decorations like xX_name_Xx and ~*~name~*~, and a Kaomoji tab beside the symbols. Show me
  • Added stacked text orientation, with stacked looks and paper and stone textures in the WordArt style gallery. Show me
  • Added two-color Pattern paints for fills, outlines, shadows, text backgrounds, and the canvas background, with presets, transparent backgrounds, motif shapes, tile layouts, spacing, offsets, and looping scroll. Show me
  • Added editable Subtitle, Caption Bar, and Date Stamp templates, plus a Demotivational Poster canvas template. Show me
  • Added clipping to show artwork only inside the layer below, following its opacity and animation. Show me
  • Filter layers can now be unlocked, moved, and resized to apply a look to a rectangular region instead of the whole canvas. Show me
  • Added stretchable stickers and frames, which protect their corners and edges as they resize, with Smart Stretch and adjustable Border Scale for frame images. Show me
  • Added Remove background for uploaded stickers, turning a PNG or JPG into a cutout, and a glitter recolor tool with a side-by-side comparison of the original and recolored glitter. Show me
  • Added SVG export for paths, shapes, text, painted fills, style frames, and non-image backgrounds, keeping gradients, patterns, strokes, arrowheads, outlines, shadows, and bevels. Text can be outlined or editable; glitter becomes a solid color, and the dialog reports omitted content. Show me
  • Added Export Size and File Size Limit to Export Settings, plus a Fit button in the result to export again under a service's upload limit. Presets include Mastodon and emoji, sticker, and icon sizes; fitting leaves the saved Export Settings unchanged. Show me
  • Added automatic recovery of unsaved work: if the page closes or crashes, the start screen offers to resume your last graphic. Show me
  • Added Take Photo to the start screen and the menu: start a graphic from a camera photo, with mirroring, a camera choice, and a countdown. Show me
  • Added one-click canvas presets to the start screen, recent custom sizes in New Canvas, and template previews that open at their own size. Show me
  • Added Balance Sidebar Widths to keep the Inspector aligned with the toolbar and Layers panel, and smoother value scrubbing for numeric controls. Show me
  • Double-click or double tap a layer to open its source, and see dimensions while drawing a Shape, Text box, or Line. Show me
  • Expanded multi-selection with show/hide, lock/unlock, shared blend modes, matching widths or heights, flipping each layer in place, and copying the active layer's appearance to unlocked layers of the same type. Show me
  • Drag across eye icons in the Layers panel to show or hide several layers in one undo step, including on touch screens. Show me

Changed

  • Expanded motion timing with start times, cycle lengths, finite repeat counts, Trim end, and Stretch duration. Changing presets keeps the timing, and travel motions also show their speed in pixels per second. Show me
  • Marquee now fits the canvas and loops seamlessly, with a choice of no repeat, an edge wrap, or a tiled row with an adjustable gap. Added looping Ricochet and Wander for layers and Sparkles. Show me
  • Improved animated export to preserve GIF and glitter frame changes at their authored times and protect distinct source frames when reducing the output. Show me
  • Expanded animation analysis and frame options to explain source timing, loop fitting, and ways to export fewer frames. Export now reports its progress step by step, and long-running work shows an activity indicator on the canvas. Show me
  • Rebuilt the workspace around one Library window for glitters, stickers, shapes, fonts, and brushes, with a right column that shows only the properties of the selected layer or active tool. Show me
  • Reorganized the glitter and sticker libraries by style and set, with adjustable tile sizes, quick picks, broader search, and clearer source and creator details. Added new fonts, glitters, and sparkle sets. Show me
  • Redesigned the phone layout around a chip bar for the selected layer's properties. Show me
  • Redesigned New Canvas, Settings, Export Settings, and Commands & Shortcuts as titled cards, with resets for a single setting, a group, or everything. Show me
  • Layer locks now block canvas transforms and property changes while leaving the layer selectable. Show me
  • Improved startup with deferred Library views and settings, a smaller boot bundle, and on-demand loading for export and background removal.

Fixed

  • Improved Undo and Redo so text typing stays in its editing session, fill clicks make one step, unfinished drags cancel cleanly, and restoring history keeps the active tool.
  • Fixed text anchoring and box resizing, sticker aspect locking, and sticker outline, shadow, and bevel sizing at different scales.
  • Fixed importing and thumbnailing older library GIFs whose frames extend beyond their declared image size.
  • Fixed the context bar not appearing for the active tool when a document starts.

Saves project files in format version 6.

Animation, Effects & Export

Version 0.5.0, October 1, 2026

Added layer animation, filter, frame, and Sparkles layers, richer layer styling, still-image export, and more faithful animation output.

Added

  • Added stackable Animation to Glitter Fill, Sticker, Text, and Shape layers, with presets for ambient movement, attention effects, motion, rainbow color, and one-time transitions. Show me
  • Added Filter layers that non-destructively process every layer beneath them, with adjustment, Instagram, Web & Film, and Pixel & Damage looks including light leaks, scanlines, dreamy glow, JPEG crunch, RGB split, and gradient maps. Show me
  • Added Frame layers with classic web borders or ornate frame images, glitter, solid, and gradient paint, and the option to follow the canvas or transform freely. Show me
  • Added animated Sparkles to layers and the canvas, with presets for glints, stars, hearts, snow, edge tracing, and Kira Kira highlights. A standalone Sparkles layer can also place weather and particles over the complete scene. Show me
  • Added one-click Style presets for Text, Shape, and Sticker layers, along with Bevel & Gloss effects and glitter or solid Sticker outlines. Show me
  • Added backgrounds to Text layers, with glitter or solid fills, presets, adjustable padding and corners, and layouts for individual lines, text bounds, or the complete text box. Show me
  • Added Text warp presets for arcs, arches, circles, bulges, waves, and flags, with adjustable bend. Show me
  • Added image fills for Shape layers, with fit, scale, alignment, offset, and pixelated or smooth sampling controls. Show me
  • Added still-image export as PNG, JPG, or GIF, with a choice of the first or current animation frame and optional generational JPG recompression. Show me
  • Added layer blend modes including Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Difference, Hue, Color, and Luminosity. Show me
  • Added a movable anchor point for each layer, controlling the point used for rotation, flipping, scaling, and animation. Show me
  • Added a Crop to Artwork canvas sizing mode that trims or extends the canvas to match the artwork, with adjustable padding. Show me
  • Added ready-made gradient presets and an eyedropper for sampling colors directly from the artwork. Show me
  • Added source and license attribution for brushes, fonts, and stickers in their asset details.
  • Added Twitter's 2016 sticker collection. Show me
  • Added a Preservation section describing how stickers, glitters, and site history are kept available long-term.

Changed

  • Moved the canvas Pixelate and Palette effects into Pixelate, Posterize, and Dither filter layers, which can now process any layers beneath them. Projects that used them open with an equivalent filter layer above the canvas. Show me
  • Rebuilt animation export planning so generated motion and animated assets share a deliberate render clock, close their loops more cleanly, and preserve authored GIF timing. Show me
  • Expanded export results and animation analysis with clearer timing, frame reduction, optimization, and output details. Show me
  • Improved GIF color selection for better gradients and overall palette quality. Show me
  • Improved sticker sharpness by automatically using higher-resolution source art when a sticker is scaled up. Show me
  • Expanded the site history into a searchable timeline and moved it into its own History section.
  • Gave each layer type its own default glitter, so a new Fill Layer, Text, Shape, and Background no longer all start on the same one.

Fixed

  • Fixed transparency edges and color sampling accuracy in GIF exports. Show me
  • Fixed still-image exports on iOS showing sharing instructions meant for animated exports. Show me

Saves project files in format version 6.

Brushes & Properties

Version 0.4.0, September 1, 2026

Added imported brush tips with scatter and jitter, rebuilt the settings sidebar, and expanded export dithering and navigation.

Added

  • Added imported tips from archived Photoshop brush packs, with a searchable, categorized gallery for choosing them. Show me
  • Added Scatter & Jitter controls for each brush, including scatter distance, dabs per stamp, size and angle jitter, and roundness and flip for imported tips. Show me
  • Added GIF Look presets and detailed dithering controls for palette size, pattern, strength, scale, edge protection, and stable or shimmering motion, with a live preview. Show me
  • Added trackpad pinch-zoom and two-finger panning, scrubby zoom with the Zoom tool, Space-drag and middle-button panning, and Zoom to Selection. Commands & Shortcuts now includes a Canvas Gestures reference. Show me
  • Expanded the gradient editor with stop snapping, reversing, duplication, keyboard controls, and adjustable smooth blending. Show me
  • Added opacity controls for multi-selected layers, including support for mixed opacity values. Show me
  • Added resizable Layers and Design sidebars that snap to useful widths and remember what you set. Show me
  • Added an optional watermark on exports, with a choice of marks. Show me
  • Added adjustable corner rounding to Square shapes. Show me

Changed

  • Redesigned every Properties and tool panel with consistent sections, compact controls, collapsible asset and effect cards, clearer empty states, and inline reverts for changed settings. Show me
  • Combined the Brush and Eraser into one Mask Brush with separate Paint and Erase settings. Erase strokes now tint the area removed so far. Show me
  • Made Layer Opacity work consistently across every layer type, fading the complete layer while keeping fill, border, and shadow opacity independent. Show me
  • Expanded Mask Brush sizes to 1,000 px and made the size slider easier to control across its full range. Imported tips now remember their own size and spacing, with edge antialiasing available directly in Mask Settings. Show me
  • Made the context toolbar draggable, so you can move it out of the way and it stays where you put it. Show me
  • Improved pixel art handling, so pixelated stickers stay crisp on the canvas and in every export instead of being smoothed. Show me
  • Improved touch handling with palm rejection, so a resting hand no longer joins a pinch gesture. Show me
  • Improved gallery and modal search, keeping group headings and pinned rows visible while filtering. Show me
  • Improved the Layers panel with clearer reorder handles and better keyboard access. Show me
  • Renamed Glitter Fill layers to Fill Layers, since they can also use solid and gradient fills. Show me
  • Renamed the color selection sliders to Color Tolerance and Edge Feather, so their names say what they do. Show me
  • Regrouped export settings into Output, Playback, Quality, and Optimization. Show me

Fixed

  • Fixed color shifts in fixed-palette GIF exports by sharing one palette across the animation. Show me
  • Fixed a new sticker picking up the color adjustments left over from the previously selected one. Show me

Saves project files in format version 2.

Projects, Export & Effects

Version 0.3.0, August 1, 2026

Added saveable projects, video export, generated glitter, and canvas-wide effects.

Added

  • Added saveable .glitter.json projects that keep layers, masks, and custom stickers editable when reopened. Show me
  • Added MP4 export alongside animated GIF. Show me
  • Added Auto Glitter, which reads an image and builds glitter layers from it. The results stay editable, and you can reopen a batch to adjust it. Show me
  • Added canvas-wide pixel effects, including pixelation, posterization, dithering, and animated shimmer. Show me
  • Added a Base Background layer that fills the canvas behind everything with an image, glitter, gradient, solid color, or transparency. Show me
  • Added gradient sources across fills, borders, shadows, and canvas backgrounds, with multiple stops and adjustable angle. Show me
  • Added editable shadows to Sticker layers, with independent source, offset, scale, opacity, and color adjustments. Show me
  • Added multi-select with shared transforms, alignment, and distribution for arranging several layers together. Show me
  • Added document scaling, so you can resize the whole composition and everything on it at once. Show me
  • Added copy and paste for selected layers, along with support for pasting images from the clipboard. Show me
  • Added the Shape gallery for browsing and placing preset shapes. Show me
  • Added bold and italic styles for Text layers. Show me
  • Added a collection of light and dark interface themes. Show me
  • Added color adjustment for stickers, letting you recolor artwork to match a palette. Show me
  • Added search and filtering across the sticker, glitter, and shape galleries, with faster on-demand loading. Show me
  • Added an Antialias Edges setting for smoother text, shape, and mask edges. Show me
  • Added optimization details to the export preview, showing frame reduction and loop closure. Show me

Changed

  • Rebuilt layer transforms with steadier scaling, smart guides, snapping to the canvas and other layers, and consistent behavior across layer types. Show me
  • Reorganized the settings sidebar around the selected layer, with a context toolbar for the active tool. Show me
  • Improved mobile gestures, drawers, and layer reordering. Show me

Fixed

  • Fixed animated stickers flickering in the preview.

Text, Shapes & Masks

Version 0.2.0, July 1, 2026

Expanded the editor beyond color-selected glitter fills with painted masks, text, and shapes.

Added

  • Added brush and eraser tools for editing Glitter Fill masks by hand, with adjustable size, spacing, and smoothing. Show me
  • Added editable Text layers with typography, layout, fill, border, and shadow controls. Show me
  • Added editable Shape layers with fill, border, and shadow controls. Show me
  • Added point and area text, so a text layer can grow with its content or wrap inside a fixed box. Show me
  • Added a library of self-hosted display fonts for Text layers. Show me
  • Added canvas size controls for changing the document dimensions after you start. Show me
  • Added a gallery picker for choosing a glitter, replacing the small swatch list. Show me
  • Added confirmation prompts before actions that discard work.

Changed

  • Unified mouse and touch input, so pointer behavior is the same on desktop and mobile. Show me
  • Renamed the Color Picker tool to Color Fill to match what it does. Show me

Touch & Detail

Version 0.1.1, February 1, 2026

Added mobile editing, blank canvases, and in-app guidance, then refined touch controls and asset details.

Added

  • Added a mobile layout with drawer panels and touch controls. Show me
  • Added blank canvas creation and preset base images for starting without an upload. Show me
  • Added the built-in guide and contextual hints based on the active tool and selected layer. Show me
  • Added custom sticker uploads for bringing in your own artwork. Show me
  • Added transform handles for scaling and rotating stickers directly on the canvas. Show me
  • Added asset details for stickers and glitters, including original source, dimensions, and frame rate. Show me
  • Added a welcome screen introducing the editor to first-time visitors.

Changed

  • Rewrote touch handling so tapping, dragging, pinch-zoom, and transforms behave predictably on phones and tablets. Show me
  • Replaced the main settings inputs with sliders for quicker adjustment.

Alpha Release

Version 0.1.0, January 1, 2026

The first public release of the layer-based glitter graphics editor.

Added

  • Added Glitter Fill layers for applying animated fills to selected image colors. Show me
  • Added Sticker layers and a browser for the archived sticker collection. Show me
  • Added layer management with move, scale, rotate, duplicate, reorder, and visibility. Show me
  • Added animated GIF export with transparency options, size warnings, and automatic frame reduction. Show me
